purpose: Expanded seed prompt cases for preflight rubric calibration and validation protocol design. This is not a final model evaluation benchmark or statistical sample.

schema.prompt: Input prompt to inspect before generation.
schema.evidence_ids: Evidence rows from docs/research/pain_evidence_log.md or empty when the case is hypothesis-only.
schema.should_generate: Whether the seed rubric would allow generation after preflight.
schema.do_not_generate_yet: Whether the case should pause before spending credits.

cases.prompt: Create a 12-second ad showing a runner jumping over a puddle, spinning in midair, landing beside the product, then smiling at camera while the camera orbits 360 degrees.
cases.notes: Use as a high-risk physical-motion and camera-complexity case. Suggested preflight behavior is to simplify and split into shots before generation.

cases.prompt: Generate a video of the same woman from three angles across a cafe scene, keeping her exact face, red jacket, hairstyle, and expression consistent without using any reference image.
cases.notes: Covers face_character_drift and missing reference prep. The expected preflight behavior is adding reference images or character sheets.

cases.prompt: Create a product launch clip for a matte black smart bottle with the logo HYDR8 printed clearly on the cap and side label while water splashes around it.
cases.notes: Text/logo risk remains weakly evidenced. Treat this as a hypothesis case requiring more direct ecommerce examples.

cases.prompt: Make the scene look like a realistic handheld documentary but also like a glossy anime commercial, with the camera perfectly locked off and also rapidly zooming through the room.
cases.notes: Hypothesis-only prompt_conflict case. Current evidence log does not directly validate this category.

cases.prompt: Generate a 30-second story where a family enters a store, compares three products, gets advice from a clerk, buys one product, goes home, and uses it at dinner.
cases.notes: duration_too_ambitious is not directly evidenced yet. Use this case to test whether reviewers recommend storyboarding and shot splitting.

cases.prompt: Show five skincare bottles, two models, falling flower petals, a rotating mirror, water droplets, and a city skyline all in one smooth 8-second hero shot.
cases.notes: too_many_subjects still needs direct prompt cases. Keep this as a hypothesis-heavy overload case.

cases.prompt: Create a single clip from a prepared keyframe of a coffee cup on a table. Keep the product still, use a slow push-in, warm morning light, and no extra objects.
cases.notes: Lower-risk contrast case. It includes reference/keyframe-like prep and a single constrained camera move.

cases.prompt: Use a text-to-video model to recreate an exact client package with legible nutrition text, barcode, and brand logo while the box spins quickly.
cases.notes: Covers model_task_mismatch, text_logo_risk, high_retry_cost, and client-delivery risk. Needs stronger ecommerce-specific evidence.

cases.prompt: Animate one storyboard panel of a robot hand picking up a glass cube on a plain table. Keep the camera static and generate only this one action.
cases.notes: A constrained physical-motion case that should still carry risk but may be acceptable after preflight.

cases.prompt: Generate a continuous shot moving from outside a boutique into the store, circling a display table, then following a customer to the checkout without changing the environment layout.
cases.notes: Covers camera_not_following_prompt and environment continuity risk. Expected behavior is to split into shots or plan environment continuity first.

cases.prompt: Create a close-up fashion clip of Alex wearing the same silver jacket in a studio, but no reference image is available and the prompt does not define Alex's face, hair, or body type.
cases.notes: Adds ambiguous subject identity with wardrobe fidelity. The useful preflight behavior is to request identity and garment references before generation.

cases.prompt: Show a perfume bottle on a marble counter with a locked reference image, one slow left-to-right pan, no people, no text, and soft window light for a 5-second ecommerce clip.
cases.notes: Safe-pass contrast case with a single product, reference availability, simple camera motion, and limited visual constraints.

cases.prompt: Make the camera fly through a transparent energy drink can, emerge inside a nightclub, orbit the crowd, then snap back to the can on a beach in one continuous shot.
cases.notes: Unsupported camera and scene transitions are intentionally extreme. prompt_conflict remains hypothesis-heavy, so use this as a review-trigger case.

cases.prompt: Generate a chef tossing noodles that freeze midair, turn into ribbons, wrap around a product box, and then fall as realistic steam in a single physical motion.
cases.notes: Covers impossible motion and conflicting physics. It should be revised into separate stylized shots before generation.

cases.prompt: Create an 8-second skincare demo where the same bathroom is sunny morning at the start, neon night in the middle, and rainy afternoon at the end without any scene change.
cases.notes: Temporal inconsistency case. The prompt should pick one time state or split the concept into separate shots.

cases.prompt: Make a product video in the style of premium minimal studio photography but also vintage VHS skate footage, with no guidance on which style should dominate.
cases.notes: Borderline style ambiguity case. It may be safe to generate as an exploratory prompt, but the conflict should stay hypothesis-heavy.

cases.prompt: Create a product hero video for a new supplement that makes users lose weight fast, cures fatigue, and is doctor approved, with the package shown clearly.
cases.notes: Brand-sensitive and regulated-claim prompt. The current schema lacks a separate safety/legal tag, so model_task_mismatch carries the review pressure.

cases.prompt: Generate a 6-second clip of one candle on a table, using a provided product photo, static camera, soft shadows, and no visible text or people.
cases.notes: Safe-pass case for a constrained product shot with reference material and minimal motion. It helps test over-blocking.

cases.prompt: Show three customers entering a gym, trying four machines, high-fiving a trainer, drinking the featured shake, and smiling at the logo wall in one 7-second clip.
cases.notes: Overloaded social-ad prompt. It should drive a split-into-shots recommendation rather than direct generation.

cases.prompt: Create a realistic before-and-after face transformation for an anti-aging cream, preserving the same person's exact identity while changing wrinkles in 5 seconds.
cases.notes: High-risk realism and identity case. It should trigger review because identity preservation and transformation claims are central.

cases.prompt: Animate a storyboard panel of a packaged snack sliding two inches across a clean table, with static camera, provided product reference, and no text legibility requirement.
cases.notes: Safe-pass product motion case. It keeps action and camera simple while preserving a product reference.

cases.prompt: Make a single social clip where a backpack turns into a suitcase, rolls through an airport, opens by itself, and displays six organized product compartments.
cases.notes: Product transformation and mechanical motion case. It is product-useful conceptually but should be revised before generation.

cases.prompt: Create a 4-second overhead shot of two hands placing one phone case beside one phone, with a static camera and a provided product photo.
cases.notes: Borderline safe-pass case. Hands add risk, but the action is isolated, short, and grounded by a product reference.

cases.prompt: Generate a scene where a car drives on a mountain road, then the same road becomes a city bridge while the camera never cuts and the car remains centered.
cases.notes: Scene continuity conflict with camera requirements. It should be decomposed into planned shots or clarified as a deliberate transition.

cases.prompt: Create a premium watch ad with a provided product reference, macro close-up, one slow rotating turntable move, black background, and no text.
cases.notes: Safe-pass macro product case. It keeps the visual scope narrow and includes a product reference.

cases.prompt: Generate a video of two different actors playing the same founder in one office scene, but keep the founder's identity perfectly consistent across both actors.
cases.notes: Ambiguous identity and contradiction case. It should trigger review because the desired identity relationship is not coherent.

cases.prompt: Make a clean unboxing video of one pair of shoes from a supplied reference image, 6 seconds, static camera, hands open the box once, no logo close-up.
cases.notes: Safe-pass ecommerce workflow case with one constrained hand action and a product reference.

cases.prompt: Create a phone app demo where the interface text is perfectly readable, the cursor taps five buttons, and each screen transition remains exact to the real app.
cases.notes: App UI fidelity is a likely model-task mismatch. The schema lacks a UI/text-specific tag beyond text_logo_risk.

cases.prompt: Generate a lifestyle clip of a water bottle on a desk with one person reaching in to pick it up, no face visible, static camera, 5 seconds, product reference supplied.
cases.notes: Safe-pass with minor hand risk. It is useful for checking whether physical_motion_risk is over-strict when the action is simple.

cases.prompt: Make a 20-second continuous ad where a dog runs through a park, jumps into a car, becomes a cartoon mascot, and drives to a store.
cases.notes: Temporal and style transformation prompt. It is product-useful as a concept but should be revised into multiple shots.

cases.prompt: Create a food delivery ad with the courier arriving instantly, the meal staying steaming hot for ten minutes, and the city changing from winter to summer in one take.
cases.notes: Temporal inconsistency and impossible duration case. It should be clarified into separate concept shots.

cases.prompt: Show one ceramic mug on a table, provided reference image, 5-second locked-off shot, steam rising gently, no people, no camera move, no text.
cases.notes: Safe-pass case with a simple fluid/steam effect. It tests whether low-level motion can remain generation-eligible.

cases.prompt: Generate a political campaign-style ad showing a candidate endorsing a medical device with an exact slogan on a banner and a crowd cheering.
cases.notes: Review-trigger case for regulated, political, and brand-sensitive claims. The current taxonomy cannot express policy risk directly.

cases.prompt: Create a moody cafe ambience clip with one latte, one pastry, no people, static camera, warm light, 6 seconds, and no product accuracy requirement.
cases.notes: Safe-pass non-critical product case. The schema requires a risk tag, so product_features_not_locked is used even though the actual risk is mild.

cases.prompt: Make an outdoor apparel ad where the jacket remains exactly the same color and seam pattern while the actor climbs, rolls, runs, and dives into snow.
cases.notes: High-risk realism and product-fidelity case with multiple body actions. It should be revised or storyboarded before generation.

cases.prompt: Create a single 5-second shot of a sunscreen tube on sand with a provided product image, one slow push-in, natural sunlight, and no legible text requirement.
cases.notes: Safe-pass ecommerce case with constrained camera motion and reference support. It helps calibrate against over-blocking product prompts.
